newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Canadian group plans hydrocarbon hunt in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Canadian group plans hydrocarbon hunt in Morocco.

text.p: A Canadian oil and gas company, Cabre Exploration Ltd, on Monday signed a $16.5 million agreement with Morocco to explore for gas or oil in the North African country.

Under the agreement, Cabre will sink between nine and 14 wells. The eight-year contract, covering three onshore permits, was signed with Morocco's National Research and Petroleum Exploitation Office (ONAREP)
"It was signed today with ONAREP, for exploration of hydrocarbons, focusing mainly on gas," a Canadian embassy spokeswoman said.
Besides the wells, the company will finance seismic exploration upto a maximum of 1,000 kms.

"In case of discovery, ONAREP and Cabre's stakes will be 35 and 65 percent respectively. The two parties will finance the development and production investment according to their stakes," the energy ministry said in a statement.
Exploration will be in the north Moroccan Gharbe du Pre-Rif region and cover an area of about 580 sq km (360 sq miles).
